posts.title: From benchmarking to fine-tuning: what I learned about small decision models
posts.description: I benchmarked Jev and its open-source alternative Laya on banking and cybersecurity tasks. Setup mattered, confidence mattered more, and fine-tuning closed most of the gap.

posts.title: I built a Digital Human you can talk to
posts.description: An engineering account of a voice-to-avatar pipeline built with Deepgram, Groq, Chroma, AWS Polly, GeneFace++, FastAPI, and WebRTC.

posts.title: How I Migrated a 350,000-Line Java/JSP Application to TypeScript in Five Days
posts.description: A one-year modernization estimate became a five-day AI-assisted migration. The decisive advantage was not code generation; it was a parity harness that gave parallel agents an objective way to verify their work.
